terms.gloss: a subject, a branch of learning
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: instruction, learning, science. To teach a subject, disciplīnam trādere (Morgan–Owens).

terms.gloss: an art, a body of knowledge with its rules
evidence: Cic. Cael. 72: iīsque artibus, quibus īnstruimur (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Q. fr. 3.9.2: litterae mē et studia nostra … dēlectant

phrases.latin: cujus prīma aetās dēdita disciplīnīs fuit iīsque artibus, quibus īnstruimur ad hunc ūsum forēnsem
phrases.english: whose early years were given to study, and to the subjects that train us for this work in the courts
